# Inspire Business Group

> Inspire Business Group LLC is a technology and education venture studio. It builds platforms built to help people learn, certify and live better, and it takes requests for websites, logos and business branding.

## Request services

- [Request services](https://www.inspirebusinesstechnology.com/#request-services): Choose a website, a logo, business branding or any mix, and describe your project. Requests go to info@inspirebusinesstechnology.com.

## Services

- Website
- Logo
- Business branding

## Products

- Forge: an AI-powered learning and testing platform. Exam prep for high-stakes certifications, starting with CISSP, with adaptive practice, deep explanations and structured study paths.
- Fluyo: AI-powered language learning that combines adaptive learning, conversational AI, real-world practice and interactive content.
- Smart Home Certification: a certification platform that certifies homes by their level of smart-technology integration, for homeowners, builders, insurers and real estate professionals. Domains: Energy, Safety, Security, Comfort, Networks, Documentation.

## About

- Mission: we build intelligent platforms that solve meaningful problems through innovation, education, and technology, helping people and organizations reach their full potential.
- Belief: technology should be intuitive, accessible, and transformative.
